## A two-column slide

::: {.splitgrid}
::: {.card .yellow}
**Hypothesis**

Pastel palettes lower perceived information density, which helps audiences absorb dense slides.
:::
::: {.card .pink}
**Caveat**

Soft colours can also flatten emphasis. Reserve a single accent for the one thing you really want noticed.
:::
:::
